## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      4 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 19 may 2026 - 27 jul 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _rybu0305_, 25 jul 2026, 1/5: "They removed the ability to easily see the month from the top view and then switch to the schedule view. App is unusable now."
            2. _Heatmiser NeoApp_, 22 may 2026, 1/5: "Apple app icon shows 31st. Should be showing the correct date! Bug only affects Apple devices and not Android"
            3. _Mumakil_, 11 jun 2026, 3/5: "It’s not bad but a few changes would get it more stars. The main issues I have are in adding an entry. Why do I have to scroll through months to get to the date I want? Drop downs to select the month and year for things way in the future would be much better. Also occasionally it freezes the keyboard when I try to enter a location. This is the only app I have that freezes anytime I’m entering information so clearly a bug in the app. Lastly why does the app icon show 31 and not the current date like the iOS calendar app does?"
